lessons.title: Partial, Expression & Covering (INCLUDE) Indexes
lessons.content: Creating optimized partial indexes with WHERE filters, functional expression indexes (lower, jsonb extractions), and covering indexes with INCLUDE clauses for index-only scans in PostgreSQL.

lessons.title: Understanding EXPLAIN ANALYZE & Query Planner Cost Models
lessons.content: Reading and analyzing PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution plans. Interpreting sequential scans, index scans, bitmap heap scans, join types (hash join, nested loop, merge join), and cost models.

lessons.title: Transaction Isolation Levels: Read Committed to Serializable
lessons.content: Understanding ACID guarantees and PostgreSQL isolation levels: Read Committed, Repeatable Read, and Serializable. Dirty reads, non-repeatable reads, phantom reads, and serialization anomalies.

lessons.title: Row-Level Locking, Advisory Locks & Deadlock Avoidance

lessons.title: Database Migration Safety Strategies and Zero Downtime
lessons.content: Designing zero-downtime schema migrations. Safe column additions, multi-phase column renames, CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY, lock timeouts, and backward-compatible DDL workflows.

lessons.title: Optimizing Database Connection Pooling under High Concurrency
lessons.content: Configuring PgBouncer and client connection pools for maximum throughput under high concurrency. Connection pool sizing, transaction vs session pooling modes, and connection exhaustion mitigation.

lessons.title: Partitioning Large Tables: Range, List & Hash Partitioning
lessons.content: Designing declarative table partitioning in PostgreSQL for high-volume datasets. Range partitioning on timestamps, list partitioning on tenants, and hash partitioning with partition pruning.

lessons.title: PostgreSQL Full-Text Search (FTS) with tsvector & GIN Indexes
lessons.content: Implementing native full-text search in PostgreSQL. Parsing text with to_tsvector, dictionary stemming, English stopword elimination, to_tsquery, ts_rank_cd relevance ranking, and GIN index acceleration.

lessons.title: Docker Multi-Stage Builds & Minimal Alpine Images
lessons.content: Optimizing container image size using Docker multi-stage builds. Separating compile-time toolchains from production runtime environments using minimal Alpine Linux and distroless base images.

lessons.title: Docker Layer Caching Strategies & BuildKit Optimization
lessons.content: Structuring Dockerfile instructions to maximize layer cache hits. Ordering package manifest copies before source code, utilizing BuildKit cache mounts, and minimizing rebuild times.

lessons.title: Container Networking: Bridge, Host & Overlay Networks
lessons.content: Deep dive into container networking drivers: default bridge networks, custom user-defined bridges, host networking, and multi-host overlay networks. DNS resolution between containers.

lessons.title: Docker Compose for Multi-Container Local Development
lessons.content: Orchestrating local full-stack development environments with Docker Compose. Defining services for NestJS API, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Next.js web with environment variable substitution and networks.

lessons.title: Managing Persistent Data with Docker Volumes and Bind Mounts
lessons.content: Configuring named Docker volumes for persistent database storage and bind mounts for live code hot-reloading. Volume drivers, permissions, and backup extraction strategies.

lessons.title: Security Hardening: Non-Root Containers & Read-Only Filesystems
lessons.content: Hardening Docker containers for production security. Creating dedicated non-root users, dropping Linux capabilities, running containers with read-only root filesystems, and avoiding privilege escalation.

lessons.title: Container Health Checks, Restart Policies & Graceful Teardown
lessons.content: Defining container health check commands, restart policies (unless-stopped, on-failure), and container lifecycle management in production container runtimes.

lessons.title: Graceful Shutdown & Signal Handling in Node.js Containers
lessons.content: Handling POSIX termination signals (SIGTERM, SIGINT) in Node.js and NestJS applications inside containers. Draining in-flight HTTP requests, closing database connection pools, and disconnecting queues cleanly.

lessons.title: Container Registries, Image Signing & Vulnerability Scanning
lessons.content: Publishing production container images to secure container registries. Automated vulnerability scanning with Trivy, image digest immutability, and container signing with Cosign.

lessons.title: Dependency Injection & Modular Architecture in NestJS
lessons.content: Mastering NestJS inversion of control (IoC) and dependency injection (DI) container. Custom providers, factory providers, dynamic modules, module exports, and scope lifecycles.

lessons.title: NestJS Middleware, Interceptors & Logging Pipelines
lessons.content: Implementing enterprise request-response pipelines in NestJS. Using HTTP middleware for request tracing, execution interceptors for response transformation and timing, and structured Winston logging.

lessons.title: Validation Pipes, DTO Transformation & Class-Validator
lessons.content: Enforcing strict runtime schema validation in NestJS using ValidationPipe, class-validator decorators, and class-transformer. Stripping non-whitelisted payload properties and preventing prototype pollution.

lessons.title: Exception Filters, Custom Exceptions & RFC-7807 Error Responses
lessons.content: Centralized error handling with NestJS Exception Filters. Mapping domain exceptions to HTTP status codes, formatting RFC-7807 Problem Details error responses, and preventing internal stack leakages.

lessons.title: Database Integration with Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL
lessons.content: Integrating Drizzle ORM with NestJS dependency injection. Defining relational schemas, query builders, relations, join queries, transaction management, and connection pooling providers.

lessons.title: Asynchronous Queues & Background Workers with BullMQ
lessons.content: Implementing background job processing with BullMQ and Redis in NestJS. Job queues, worker concurrency, retry backoff strategies, dead-letter queues, and event listeners.

lessons.title: Task Scheduling, Cron Jobs & Distributed Locks with Redis
lessons.content: Scheduling recurring cron jobs in NestJS with @nestjs/schedule and BullMQ repeatable jobs. Preventing duplicate execution across multiple replicas using Redis Redlock distributed locking.

lessons.title: Event-Driven Architecture using Outbox Pattern and Message Queues
lessons.content: Designing reliable event-driven systems using the Transactional Outbox pattern. Writing domain events within the same database transaction as business entities and dispatching to message brokers via polling or Debezium CDC.

lessons.title: Microservices Communication: gRPC, RabbitMQ & Redis Pub/Sub
lessons.content: Evaluating inter-service communication protocols in modern microservice architectures. High-performance synchronous gRPC RPCs versus asynchronous message queuing with RabbitMQ and Redis Pub/Sub.

lessons.title: React 19 Compiler, Actions & Server Component Boundaries
lessons.content: Exploring the React 19 architecture: automatic memoization via React Compiler, Server Action transitions, use server directives, and defining strict boundaries between Server and Client Components.

lessons.title: Concurrent React: useTransition, useDeferredValue & Suspense
lessons.content: Building ultra-responsive user interfaces with React Concurrent mode. Non-blocking UI updates using useTransition, deferred rendering with useDeferredValue, and nested Suspense fallbacks.

lessons.title: Form State Management with useActionState & useFormStatus
lessons.content: Managing complex form lifecycles natively in React 19 without external state libraries. Handling pending form submissions with useFormStatus and binding server action returns with useActionState.

lessons.title: Optimistic UI Updates with useOptimistic Hook
lessons.content: Implementing instantaneous client feedback using the React 19 useOptimistic hook. Updating UI state optimistically before server confirmation, with automatic rollback on server error.

lessons.title: Advanced Custom Hooks Architecture & Code Reusability
lessons.content: Designing robust custom hooks for browser event listeners, debounce/throttle coordination, WebSocket streaming connections, and data synchronization across browser tabs.

lessons.title: Frontend Performance Optimization & Bundle Splitting
lessons.content: Optimizing Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) in Next.js applications. Dynamic imports (next/dynamic), tree shaking, route-based code splitting, font optimization, and script loading strategies.

lessons.title: Virtualized Lists & Infinite Scrolling for High-Volume Data
lessons.content: Rendering massive datasets without DOM bloat using windowing and virtualized lists (@tanstack/react-virtual). Fixed and dynamic item heights, scroll synchronization, and bidirectional infinite loading.

lessons.title: Web Accessibility (a11y), ARIA Roles & Screen Reader Testing
lessons.content: Implementing WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards in web applications. Semantic landmarks, ARIA live regions, keyboard focus traps, screen reader testing with NVDA/VoiceOver, and automated axe-core audits.

lessons.title: Internationalization (i18n), RTL Layouts & Localization
lessons.content: Designing multi-lingual full-stack applications. Dynamic route localization, ICU message formatting, pluralization, RTL (right-to-left) CSS mirroring, and date/currency formatting for international users.

lessons.title: Automated CI/CD Pipelines with GitHub Actions
lessons.content: Building enterprise CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions. Automated linting, Vitest unit test execution, Docker build cache integration, artifact uploading, and branch deployment automation to Render.

lessons.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform & Render Blueprints
lessons.content: Managing declarative cloud infrastructure using Render Blueprints (render.yaml) and Terraform. Defining web services, managed PostgreSQL databases, Redis key-value stores, and environment variables.

lessons.title: Zero-Downtime Blue-Green & Rolling Deployment Strategies
lessons.content: Architecting zero-downtime deployment pipelines. Comparing rolling container deployments with blue-green environments, traffic routing, health check validation, and automated instant rollbacks.

lessons.title: Production Observability: Structured Logging, Tracing & APM
lessons.content: Implementing production observability. JSON structured logging with correlation IDs, OpenTelemetry distributed tracing across HTTP microservices, error tracking with Sentry, and APM metrics.

lessons.title: Health Checks, Readiness Probes & Self-Healing Architecture
lessons.content: Designing multi-level health checks in web services. Liveness probes for process hangs, readiness probes verifying database and Redis connectivity, and orchestrator self-healing restarts.

lessons.title: TLS Certificates, HTTPS Configuration & DNS Management
lessons.content: Configuring modern transport layer security (TLS 1.3), automated Let’s Encrypt certificate issuance, DNS record types (A, CNAME, ALIAS), CAA records, and HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS).

lessons.title: CDN Edge Caching, Cache-Control Headers & Purge Invalidation
lessons.content: Accelerating global asset delivery with Content Delivery Networks (Vercel Edge, Cloudflare). Stale-While-Revalidate caching headers, surrogate keys, cache invalidation webhooks, and edge execution.

lessons.title: Secret Management, HashiCorp Vault & Runtime Environment Security
lessons.content: Safeguarding API secrets, database credentials, and cryptographic keys. Secret injection into container environments, dynamic secret rotation, auditing secret access, and avoiding repo leaks.

lessons.title: Disaster Recovery, Database Backup Automation & RPO/RTO
lessons.content: Formulating disaster recovery strategies. Automated pg_dump snapshot cron jobs, encrypted off-site backup storage in S3/Cloud Storage, point-in-time recovery (PITR), and meeting RPO/RTO targets.

lessons.title: Event Streaming Architecture: Telemetry Beacons & Ingestion
lessons.content: Designing scalable learner telemetry event streaming. Schema definition for learning events, video playback tracking, quiz attempts, high-concurrency ingestion endpoints, and queue buffering.

lessons.title: Client-Side Beacon Transport: sendBeacon & Page-Exit Lifecycle
lessons.content: Implementing reliable client-side telemetry transmission using navigator.sendBeacon and fetch keepalive during page unloads, visibility changes, and mobile browser tab closures.

lessons.title: Data Privacy by Design: HMAC-SHA256 Pseudonymization & PII Stripping
lessons.content: Enforcing GDPR and strict student privacy in telemetry data. Daily rotating HMAC-SHA256 user pseudonymization, stripping PII, parameter allowlisting, and unauthenticated tracking rejection.

lessons.title: High-Throughput Batch Ingestion & Rate-Limiting Sliding Windows
lessons.content: Handling high-volume telemetry surges using batch insertion APIs and sliding-window rate limiters. Enforcing rate limits per enrolled learner to protect backend databases from DDOS.

lessons.title: Time-Series Aggregations & Window Functions in PostgreSQL
lessons.content: Writing high-performance SQL analytical queries over time-series learning events. Using window functions, lead/lag, cumulative distributions, and date_trunc for learner progress analytics.

lessons.title: Automated Data Retention, Pruning Workers & Table Partitioning
lessons.content: Managing database storage limits on cloud tiers using automated BullMQ pruning workers. Scheduled chunked deletion of high-frequency video checkpoints older than 90 days.

lessons.title: Calculating Student Drop-Off Curves with SQL Aggregations
lessons.content: Aggregating granular video playhead checkpoints to compute lesson drop-off curves. Calculating 10-percentile completion distributions and identifying student confusion hotspots.

lessons.title: Building Accessible Data Visualization Charts with SVG
lessons.content: Constructing performant, accessible data visualization charts in React using native SVG elements. Rendering video retention curves, area charts, screen reader data tables, and high-contrast modes.

lessons.title: Configuring Redis Cache Expiration and Eviction Policies
lessons.content: Optimizing Redis cache layers for analytics endpoints. Cache invalidation on new course enrollments, TTL expiration strategies, and configuring maxmemory-policy (allkeys-lru, noeviction).

lessons.title: How to Prevent SQL Injection in Drizzle ORM
lessons.content: Securing database access against SQL injection attacks. Understanding parameterized queries in Drizzle ORM, avoiding raw SQL string concatenation, and validating user input with Zod schemas.

lessons.title: Securing RESTful APIs against Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and Request Forgery (CSRF)
lessons.content: Mitigating XSS and CSRF in full-stack applications. Sanitizing user HTML content with DOMPurify, configuring SameSite cookie attributes, and validating anti-CSRF tokens in mutating endpoints.

lessons.title: Content Security Policy (CSP), CORS & Secure HTTP Headers
lessons.content: Configuring HTTP security headers using Helmet in NestJS and Next.js. Defining strict Content Security Policies, restricting cross-origin resource sharing (CORS), and blocking framing.

lessons.title: How to Implement Refresh Token Rotation Securely
lessons.content: Implementing secure refresh token rotation to mitigate token theft. Storing hashed refresh tokens in PostgreSQL, detecting token reuse, revoking user sessions, and setting HttpOnly cookies.

lessons.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) with TOTP & Recovery Codes
lessons.content: Implementing multi-factor authentication in web applications using Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTP). Generating QR codes, verifying authenticator tokens, and hashing emergency recovery codes.

lessons.title: Password Hashing with Argon2id & Bcrypt Salt Discipline
lessons.content: Evaluating cryptographic password hashing algorithms. Benchmarking Argon2id against Bcrypt, configuring memory cost and iteration parameters, generating unique salts, and constant-time verification.

lessons.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Object-Level Permission Guards
lessons.content: Implementing granular authorization in NestJS. Role-based access control with custom decorators, object-level ownership guards, and multi-tenant resource isolation preventing IDOR vulnerabilities.

lessons.title: Rate Limiting, DDoS Mitigation & IP Reputation Filtering
lessons.content: Protecting public API endpoints from brute force and denial of service attacks. Configuring distributed rate limiting using Redis sliding logs (@nestjs/throttler) and Cloudflare IP firewalls.

lessons.title: Security Auditing, Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessment
lessons.content: Conducting systematic security audits and automated vulnerability scans. Using OWASP ZAP for penetration testing, auditing npm dependencies with audit-ci, and implementing security disclosure policies.

lessons.content: Engineering accessible data visualizations. Accompanying visual SVG line and bar charts with hidden HTML data tables for screen reader users, keyboard focusable data points, and high contrast styling.

lessons.courseTitle: Accessible UI, Design Systems & Data Visualization
lessons.title: Micro-Interactions, CSS Keyframe Animations & GPU Acceleration

lessons.courseTitle: Accessible UI, Design Systems & Data Visualization

lessons.content: Building accessible modal dialogs, drawers, and popovers in React. Managing keyboard focus trapping, restoring focus on close, escape key dismissals, and aria-expanded attributes.

lessons.courseTitle: Accessible UI, Design Systems & Data Visualization

lessons.content: Optimizing web images for fast load times. Next.js image optimization, modern compressed image formats (AVIF, WebP), responsive srcset attributes, and blur-up placeholder techniques.

lessons.title: SSLCommerz Payment Gateway Integration & IPN Verification
lessons.content: Integrating SSLCommerz payment gateway for Bangladesh payment processing (bKash, Nagad, Visa, Mastercard). Session creation, redirection, Instant Payment Notification (IPN) webhook validation, and hash verification.

lessons.title: End-to-End Testing Strategy for Financial Payment Workflows
lessons.content: Designing reliable end-to-end testing suites for payment checkout workflows. Mocking third-party payment gateways, simulating sandbox IPN callbacks, payment cancellations, and failure recovery.

lessons.title: Idempotent Payment Webhooks & Replay Attack Defense
lessons.content: Securing asynchronous payment webhooks against duplicate delivery and replay attacks. Enforcing database idempotency keys, verifying transaction numbers, and recording payment audit logs.

lessons.title: Double-Entry Bookkeeping & Immutable Financial Ledger Architecture
lessons.content: Architecting an immutable financial ledger with double-entry bookkeeping principles. Balanced debits and credits per transaction, ledger account types (platform cash, revenue, instructor payable), and audit trails.

lessons.title: Escrow Settlement, Refund Clawbacks & Multi-Source Reconciliation
lessons.content: Managing course purchase escrow holding periods (30 days), automatic escrow settlement, handling student refund clawbacks from instructor pending balances, and multi-source financial reconciliation.

lessons.title: Floating-Point Error Prevention: Integer BDT Poisha Arithmetic
lessons.content: Eliminating rounding and precision bugs in financial systems. Storing all monetary amounts in integer BDT poisha cents (1 BDT = 100 poisha), exact integer division, and non-negative check constraints.

lessons.title: Instructor Wallet Architecture, Payout Holds & Clearance Cycles
lessons.content: Designing instructor monetization wallets. Available balance versus pending balance, payout request workflows, automated balance deduction, admin review approval, and settlement reference recording.

lessons.title: Invoice Generation, PDF Rendering & Tax Compliance
lessons.content: Automating tax-compliant invoice generation upon successful course checkout. Server-side PDF rendering using React-PDF, sequential invoice numbering, and customer receipt downloads.

lessons.title: Financial Auditing, Ledger Balance Invariants & Anomaly Detection
lessons.content: Implementing automated integrity checks for financial platforms. Verifying mathematical balance invariants (sum of debits == sum of credits), detecting anomalous transactions, and audit alerting.

lessons.title: Kubernetes Architecture: Control Plane, Nodes & Pod Scheduling
lessons.content: Understanding Kubernetes architectural building blocks. Control plane components (API server, etcd, controller manager, kube-scheduler), worker node kubelet, kube-proxy, and pod scheduling algorithms.

lessons.title: Deployments, ReplicaSets & Declarative Pod Lifecycle
lessons.content: Managing container workloads with Kubernetes Deployments and ReplicaSets. Declarative pod specs, rolling update strategies, maxUnavailable/maxSurge parameters, and rollbacks.

lessons.title: Services, ClusterIP, NodePort & LoadBalancer Networking
lessons.content: Kubernetes internal and external service networking. ClusterIP for internal service discovery, NodePort for external port mapping, and cloud LoadBalancer service integration.

lessons.title: Kubernetes Ingress Controller & TLS Termination
lessons.content: Routing external HTTP/HTTPS traffic to internal services using Kubernetes Ingress controllers (NGINX, Traefik). Path-based routing, host-based routing, and cert-manager automated TLS termination.

lessons.title: ConfigMaps, Secrets & Environment Injection in Kubernetes
lessons.content: Decoupling configuration and secrets from container images in Kubernetes. Mounting ConfigMaps and encrypted Secrets as environment variables or volume files into running pods.

lessons.title: Persistent Volumes (PV), Claims (PVC) & StatefulSet Storage
lessons.content: Managing stateful workloads in Kubernetes. PersistentVolumes (PV), PersistentVolumeClaims (PVC), storage classes, dynamic volume provisioning, and StatefulSets for databases.

lessons.title: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) & Metrics Server Integration
lessons.content: Autoscaling Kubernetes workloads dynamically based on CPU and memory utilization using Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA). Configuring Metrics Server, target thresholds, and cooldown periods.

lessons.title: Liveness, Readiness & Startup Probes for Container Resilience
lessons.content: Configuring Kubernetes container probes for zero-downtime reliability. Startup probes for slow-booting applications, liveness probes for deadlocks, and readiness probes for traffic routing.

lessons.title: Helm Charts, Package Management & Templating for K8s
lessons.content: Packaging and deploying multi-service Kubernetes applications using Helm. Chart structure, values.yaml customization, Go template syntax, release versioning, and Helm rollback commands.

lessons.title: Service Mesh Fundamentals: Envoy, Istio & Mutual TLS (mTLS)
lessons.content: Implementing enterprise service mesh architectures in Kubernetes using Istio and Envoy sidecars. Zero-trust mutual TLS (mTLS) encryption, traffic shifting, canary releases, and distributed tracing.
